_comment: Bug Zapper — a 3D manifold toy. Bugs ride the invisible Schwarz Diamond surface, drawn to the light; touch the grid and they're zapped. The ambient music's notes are sampled from the manifold.
name: Bug Zapper
description: Vibrant gem-bugs fly along an invisible Schwarz Diamond surface toward the light and get zapped — flash, sparks, and a synthesized buzz, with generative bug-music drawn from the manifold. A relaxing, single-player toy.
